 mod SelfhostLexerV2 do
   # The lexer's own token stream — projected onto `Rian.Lexer`'s tokens by the
   # fixpoint harness (TNum -> {:num}, TId -> {:id}, TKw -> {:kw}, TOp -> {:op}, …).

+  type Tok := TNum(Int64) | TPlus | TMinus | TStar | TSlash | TLP | TRP | TId(String) | TKw(String) | TOp(String) | TStr(String) | TChar(Int64)
 
   pub def tokenize(src String) Vec(Tok) := lex(Prim.str_chars(src))
 
   def lex(cs Vec(Char)) Vec(Tok)
   def lex([]) := []
   def lex([c | rest]) when c == ' ' := lex(rest)
+  # string literal: scan to the closing `"` (slice 3)
+  def lex(['"' | rest]) := scan_str(rest, [])
+  # char literal `'X'`: one codepoint between single quotes (slice 3, no escapes)
+  def lex(['\'' | rest]) := scan_char(rest)
   # two-char comparison operators FIRST (longest match: `<=` before `<`)
   def lex(['<', '=' | rest]) := [TOp("<=") | lex(rest)]
   def lex(['>', '=' | rest]) := [TOp(">=") | lex(rest)]
@@ -57,6 +66,17 @@ mod SelfhostLexerV2 do
   def lex_num([c | rest], acc) when c >= '0' and c <= '9' := lex_num(rest, acc * 10 + c - '0')
   def lex_num(cs, acc) := [TNum(acc) | lex(cs)]
 
+  # a string literal: accumulate chars (reversed) until the closing `"`, then
+  # rebuild in source order (portable, no host FFI). (Slice 3 — no escapes yet.)
+  def scan_str(cs Vec(Char), acc Vec(Char)) Vec(Tok)
+  def scan_str(['"' | rest], acc) := [TStr(Prim.str_from_chars(rev(acc, []))) | lex(rest)]
+  def scan_str([c | rest], acc) := scan_str(rest, [c | acc])
+  def scan_str([], acc) := [TStr(Prim.str_from_chars(rev(acc, [])))]
+
+  # a char literal `'X'`: the codepoint of the single char, then the closing `'`.
+  def scan_char(cs Vec(Char)) Vec(Tok)
+  def scan_char([c, q | rest]) when q == '\'' := [TChar(Prim.char_code(c)) | lex(rest)]
+
   # a run of identifier chars -> the name string, classified as keyword / word-op
